svg.text: a faceted swell under a clean horizon; the sea owns mid blue
A. At fight distance, noon: the ground profile, the cover silhouettes, the far land as a value ladder. The two grey figures are 75 units tall (a fighter): scale only, no character art.
Palette at noon (the world-light tint per sky key multiplies it; lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; the far ladder is each ridge hazed toward the horizon)

Readability (docs/art/dynamic-sky.md section 6): worst aura against any tone 21.0 CIEDE2000 (rule: 20 or more), worst Protagonist or rival body against ground, rock or vegetation 22.2 (rule: 15 or more), over every sky key with the world-light tint.
B. What the fight leaves: scorched (a beam along the ground), cratered (an impact), burned (fire on what grows)
a steam line along the surface where the beam crossed, and a dark wake:
the sea does not scar, so it is the only mark and it is gone in about two
a bowl of water: the surface drops 40 units, a faceted ring of swell runs
out and the bowl fills from the sides
charred wreckage and a few burning planks float on the swell; steam banks

C. Destruction in open ocean: the impact at three moments (burst, peak, settle). A water column: a tall pale core, a collapsing cap, then a faceted ring wave. Spray is cut crystals of pale blue, never a soft cloud.
D. Where it meets its neighbours (hard steps in colour, never a fade; the cover mixes over about a third of the width)
Open ocean to Beach and coast
The sea shallows in three hard steps (deep, mid, shallow) and a pale foam line
runs along the sand; wet sand is a darker band above it.
The sea darkens to polar water and floe fragments appear, thickening into the
pack; the floe edges are slate.
A river-mouth: the shallows go tea-green in steps, reed islands stand out in the
water, the shoreline is a mud bank.
Black cliffs drop straight into the sea; sea stacks stand off the cliff; a thin
steam vent stands on the shore (grey facets).
